sentences.en: I hope it'll come, because the trash can is full.
sentences.zh: 我希望它会来，因为垃圾桶已经满了。

sentences.en: The hungry cat scattered the trash all over the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 那只饥饿的猫把垃圾撒得到处都是。

sentences.en: Dan trashed his room and stormed out of the house.
sentences.zh: 丹把他的房间弄得一团糟然后气冲冲地离开了房子。

senses.zh: 垃圾，废物；断枝，碎块；废话
